# ØRIONS — Stories, refined.

> ØRIONS (orions.agency) is a boutique creative company in Bangkok that helps brands uncover, refine and express the stories that make them worth remembering. It works from brand thinking through creative execution: it starts by understanding who a brand is, what it believes and what is worth telling, then turns that into strategy, identity, campaign, film, content or digital experience that all speak the same language. Founder & Creative Director: Ratthakan Suwanphakdee (รัฐกันต์ สุวรรณภักดี).

## The idea
Every star has its own light. A brand is made of countless details — its story, people, products, beliefs, culture, experiences and decisions — but not everything needs to be told. ØRIONS finds which stars should be seen, which should be connected, and which story should be remembered. "We don't create the stars. We reveal the constellation." The constellation is a principle, not an aesthetic: point → connection → form → meaning.

## Belief
Most brands don't need more content. They need more clarity. ØRIONS does not start from "what content should we make?" but from "what is worth saying?" Good creativity is knowing what matters, what is unnecessary, what should be amplified and what should be cut. Less noise. More meaning.

## Capabilities — Story → Direction → Expression (https://orions.agency/practice)
- STORY — Find what matters. Brand Strategy, Brand Positioning, Research & Insight, Brand Narrative, Naming, Messaging, Creative Strategy, Communication Platform, Campaign Concept.
- DIRECTION — Shape how the story should feel. Creative Direction, Brand Identity, Visual Identity, Art Direction, Design System, Campaign Direction, Key Visual, Editorial Direction, Content Direction.
- EXPRESSION — Bring the story into the world. Film, Photography, Commercial Production, Branded Content, Social Content, Campaign Assets, Website, Digital Experience, Brand Experience, Activation, Creative Production.
A brand can enter at any point, or ØRIONS can carry the whole journey. Whatever the starting point, the question stays the same: does everything tell the same story?

## Process
Discover (find the stars) → Connect (connect the dots) → Shape (shape the story) → Refine (remove what doesn't belong) → Express (bring it to life). From scattered points to a story worth remembering.

## Approach
Boutique by design. ØRIONS works with a limited number of projects so the team stays close enough to understand, to challenge, and to care about the details others overlook. Refinement cannot be mass-produced. Not a content factory, not a production line, not trend-first, not creative for creativity's sake.

## Key lines
- Stories, refined. (primary)
- We don't invent stories. We reveal them.
- Meaning before medium.

- One story. Many expressions.
